01 / SELECT FIRMWARE

LOCAL VERIFICATION

The browser accepts only the verified official V15 SHA-256. Files are not uploaded anywhere.

IMPORTANT: ETCH V1.34–V1.38 use the V15 bootheader, NOT the legacy ETCH header. AUTO selects the pinned header. Unknown firmware remains unverified; stop on CHECK refusal.

ETCH / V1.75 SHARED UNDO MEMORY + STABILITY

V1.75 reduces DSP RAM usage with no removed features. The app-only OTA path retains the fixed ETCH identity and its trusted loader, while the WebInstaller can select a legacy protected header for supported older installations. Hardware OTA safety and cross-firmware transitions remain unverified.

IDENTITYCHECKINGSIZE...SHA-256VERIFYING...
V1.38 FIX: If the connected device reports FM-1_1038, AUTO selects the original V15 bootheader. The older installer selected the ETCH header and V1.38 rejected CHECK with error -5 after 18 blocks. Do not flash a mismatched header.
BEFORE INSTALL: For experimental firmware installation, first back up your ETCH patches. This build selects the historically matched variant for known ETCH versions; the app-only OTA loader preserves the installed boot region. Stock restore requires a responsive updater and the verified official stock file; it is not a recovery guarantee.
UNVERIFIED LAB FIRMWARE. THIS IS NOT A CERTIFIED RELEASE. Includes the multitimbral GROUPS engine, but has not passed physical FM1 hardware qualification. A failed boot may require hardware-level recovery. Returning to official V15 requires a responsive USB updater; it cannot fix a completely inaccessible device. This installer does not back up user data.

Use desktop Chrome or Edge. Connect the FM1 directly with a USB data cable, and close DAWs and other MIDI applications. Do not unplug during installation.

EVENT LOG

READ-ONLY DEVICE CHECK only sends identity queries; it does not start any update or write to flash. A reboot between CHECK and FLASH is expected. If it reconnects to the old version instead of the OTA loader, the log records it. Save the log if an update fails.

A successful USB transfer is not enough. This installer reports success only after the FM1 restarts and returns the exact expected firmware identity. Cross-firmware installation requests the normal device-side CHECK first; a failed CHECK is never bypassed.
